description: This source file implements image loading, cropping, rendering, and cleanup routines using OpenGL and stb_image, for a graphics or game engine, with integration into a Lua scripting environment.

classes.name: lu5_image
classes.description: Represents an image texture, containing GLuint texture ID and dimensions.

methods.name: lu5_image * lu5_load_image(lu5_State * l5,const char * image_path)
methods.description: Loads an image from disk, creates an OpenGL texture, and registers it within the Lua environment.

methods.name: lu5_image * lu5_image_crop(lu5_State * l5,lu5_image * image,int x,int y,int w,int h)
methods.description: Creates a cropped version of an existing image texture.

methods.name: void lu5_render_image(lua_State * L,GLuint texture,lua_Number x,lua_Number y,lua_Number w,lua_Number h,lu5_color color)
methods.description: Renders the image texture at specified coordinates with specified size and color.

methods.name: void lu5_close_image(lu5_image * image)
methods.description: Deletes the OpenGL texture and frees the image structure.

methods.name: void lu5_close_images(lu5_State * l5)
methods.description: Closes all images stored in the Lua environment's image list.

ctags.name: lu5_image_crop
ctags.pattern: /^lu5_image *lu5_image_crop(lu5_State *l5, lu5_image *image, int x, int y, int w, int h) $/

ctags.pattern: /^void lu5_render_image(lua_State* L, GLuint texture, lua_Number x, lua_Number y, lua_Number w, lu/
